svg.title: Excel at a glance, with a learning order
svg.desc: Mind map of Excel for data analysts. Branches in workflow order: Get data in, Clean it, Calculate, Summarise, Show it, plus Basics and Automate. Calculate (XLOOKUP, IF, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS) and Summarise (sort and filter, PivotTables) are thickest because analysts use them every day. Automate (macros, Power Pivot) is rare in entry roles. Below: the same Birmingham question as the SQL map, solved in Excel, and a note that adverts asking for advanced Excel usually mean lookups and PivotTables.
svg.text: find a value in another table
Ctrl+T: a range becomes a table
LINE THICKNESS = HOW MUCH AN ANALYST USES IT
